passage:
**Items sold at Aling Nena's sari-sari store**

| Item | Monday | Tuesday | Wednesday |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Bread | 24 | 30 | 18 |
| Eggs | 36 | 28 | 40 |
| Coffee sachets | 15 | 22 | 19 |
| Soft drinks | 12 | 16 | 20 |
stem: How many coffee sachets did the store sell from Monday to Wednesday in all?
hints: "In all" means add. Use only the Coffee sachets row.
Read the three numbers in the Coffee sachets row: Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday.
Add two of the numbers first, then add the third. Remember to carry.

steps.action: Find the Coffee sachets row: 15, 22 and 19.
steps.why: "Monday to Wednesday" means all three days, so you need three numbers.
In the ones, 7 + 9 = 16. Write 6 and carry 1. In the tens, 3 + 1 + 1 = 5.

steps.action: The store sold 56 coffee sachets in all.

trapNotes.37: This adds only Monday and Tuesday (15 + 22). Add Wednesday's 19 too.
trapNotes.41: This adds only Tuesday and Wednesday (22 + 19). Add Monday's 15 too.
trapNotes.46: This forgets to carry the 1 when adding 37 + 19. In the ones, 7 + 9 = 16, so carry 1 to the tens.
